subject: Re: invoice and milestone dates
text:
To get straight to the point, the original invoice remains valid, but the new amount now includes a shipping surcharge I did not anticipate. When I replied before, I assumed domestic delivery would be handled by the warehouse at no extra cost. It turned out the package was too heavy for the standard courier, so the replacement component needed special handling. I understand this is frustrating, especially since we already paid for faster dispatch.

I can clarify the deadlines without changing the scope. The first milestone can stay unchanged, provided you confirm the revised fee by Friday. If confirmation slips past Friday, the second milestone moves back by five working days because our workshop schedule is built around approved purchase orders. The third milestone would then shift by the same number of days.

I can offer two simple options. Option one: pay the surcharge now, and the current delivery plan remains intact. Option two: choose slower ground shipping, remove the expedited insurance, and the surcharge disappears, although the final installation moves back by one week.

I can also keep the training session the same date unless you choose the slower shipping. I am sorry for the unexpected expense. It was outside the estimate you originally saw, and I should have checked the courier rules sooner. Please reply today if possible. I can also provide a short summary for whoever needs to approve it. Let me know which option you prefer, and I will adjust the paperwork immediately.

Thanks,
